parameters.content:
## Approved Google Sheets rows to SocialBu
1. Import calendar.csv into a tab named Posts. Keep all headers.
2. Set spreadsheet_id in Settings; leave preview_only true.
3. Select a Google Sheets credential in Read calendar and both Sheets update nodes.
4. Select a Header Auth credential in all three HTTP nodes: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN.
5. Run Connected accounts to find account_id and any team_id.
6. Approve one future row and run the preview. Review Prepare row / Preview result.
7. Set preview_only false, test one row, then publish/activate this workflow.

One row per five-minute run, in sheet order. Keep times at least 15 minutes ahead and allow time for the backlog. No AI credential required.

## Check before retrying
scheduled means accepted for scheduling, not published.
processing or needs_review: inspect SocialBu and the execution first. A lost response may hide a saved post. Never automatically retry a failed create or reset these rows.
awaiting_approval: approve in SocialBu.
media_error / needs_fix: fix the row, then set status to approved.

Use one active workflow per sheet. Pause it before manual runs. Google Sheets is not an atomic lock: overlapping runs can create duplicates. Do not edit a processing row or clear a recorded post ID. See README for recovery and verification limits.
